sentences.text:
(i) "For issuance of direction upon the respondents to follow the procedures rules and regulation of "THE RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITOIN, REHABILIATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013" and thereafter acquire the land of the petitioner situated in village-Chitarapur, P.S.-
Balumath, Thana no. 210, being Khata No. 99, plot no. 162 total measuring an area of 73 decimals.

entities.text: RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
(ii) For issuance of direction upon the respondents to give compensation to the petitioner for the land which has been acquired by the respondents for the construction of Tori-Shivpur Railway Line,
which is situated in village-Chitarapur, P.S.-Balumath, thana no. 210, being Khata no. 99, plot no.
162 total measuring an area of 73 decimals.
(iii) For issuance of direction upon the respondents to give the employment and compensation to the petitioner as per the provision laid down in National rehabilitation and resettlement policy 2007."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this writ petition.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents have no objection to the prayer made.
5. Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
6. Pending I.A., if any, is closed.
7. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
